643-7487-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
643-7487-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Maskwood Nexus, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Zealous Lorecaster token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

443-3845-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
443-3845-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit, Magus of the Bridge and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3443-4613-4687.easyPrerequisites:
Gilder Bairn is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Deathbloom Ritualist has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3443-4613-4687.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard.
3443-4613-4687.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {G/U}{G/U}{G/U}.
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling the counters on target permanent.
Repeat.

141-1070-2921.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1070-2921.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

339-677-1879-8095.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1170-5131-6797-7054--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-6797-7054--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Gravebreaker Lamia.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

654-1479-5700-5701-7885.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
654-1479-5700-5701-7885.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Down in the Valley trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Down in the Valley and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Down in the Valley triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2919-4659-5086-5183-7824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2919-4659-5086-5183-7824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

1563-2457-3480-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2488-6777-7167.description:
Cast Apex Altisaur by paying {7}{G}{G}.
When Apex Altisaur enters, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, cast Unbreakable Formation by paying its mana cost, giving creatures you control indestructible until end of turn.
Resolve the Apex Altisaur trigger, causing it to fight a creature you don't control.
If the opposing creature dealt damage to Apex Altisaur, Apex Altisaur's second ability and Wrathful Raptors trigger.
Resolve the Wrathful Raptors trigger, dealing damage to any opponent.
Resolve the Apex Altisaur trigger, causing it to fight a creature you don't control.
Repeat from step 4 until your opponents control no creatures. If they happen to control an indestructible creature with power above 0, this loop can be done infinitely.
2488-6777-7167.notes: You can restart the loop if opponents control creatures by dealing damage to Apex Altisaur. It may not have indestructible by this point however unless you use another source to provide it.

2550-3055-3953-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emrakul's Hatcher, adding {W}.
When Emrakul's Hatcher dies, Mazzy's second ability and Gift of Immortality trigger.
Resolve the Mazzy trigger, exiling Gift of Immortality with the ability to cast it until end of your next turn.
Resolve the Gift of Immortality trigger, returning Emrakul's Hatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Emrakul's Hatcher enters, it triggers, creating three creature tokens.
Activate two creature tokens by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Gift of Immortality from exile by paying {2}{W}, attaching it to Emrakul's Hatcher.
Repeat.

2523-2869-7193.description:
Cast Omni-Changeling by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Omni-Changeling into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Omni-Changeling dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Omni-Changeling that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Omni-Changeling token instead.
2523-2869-7193.notes: This combo produces a mandatory infinite loop that'll cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

1594-3532-5078-7656.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
1594-3532-5078-7656.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Elena triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4885-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
3259-4885-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4885-7358.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

116-7163-7172.description:
Activate Sunken Palace's second ability by paying {1}{U}, tapping it and exiling seven cards from your graveyard, adding {U}.
Put any triggered ability on the stack.
Holding priority, activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, ensuring to use the mana from Sunken Palace, targeting a triggered ability.
Sunken Palace triggers. Holding priority, activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Mister Fantastic.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {1}{R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, copying Sunken Palace's trigger twice.
Resolve the first Sunken Palace trigger, copying Mister Fantastic's ability, targeting a Sunken Palace trigger.
Resolve the Mister Fantastic ability, copying Sunken Palace's trigger twice.
Repeat from step 6.

969-2366-2800-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
969-2366-2800-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mirari's Wake triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-2034-3490-4506.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-2034-3490-4506.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

2292-6132-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

2173-3558-5220-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

141-313-2438.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-313-2438.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Corpse Dance.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Corpse Dance.
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4050-5968-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

7-1621-6867.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-1621-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1429-2438-6792.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

678-2438-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
678-2438-6749.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Anticausal Vestige.
When Anticausal Vestige dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, causing you to return Anticausal Vestige from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Anticausal Vestige trigger, causing you to reveal the top cards of your library and put it into your graveyard if its a creature card, or draw a card otherwise, and then put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2530-2577-5070-6518.easyPrerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
2530-2577-5070-6518.description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Angelic Chorus trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the Zombie Druid enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Angelic Chorus trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

2793-3129-3743-4444-5089.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3129-3743-4444-5089.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Noose Constrictor by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

791-1605-3231-3693.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
791-1605-3231-3693.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

188-1416-2178.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
188-1416-2178.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

2034-2341-4909.description:
Activate Melira by exiling it.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Melira's ability.
Resolve the copy of Melira's ability, choosing The Peregrine Dynamo.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing The Peregrine Dynamo, adding {C}{C}.
Melira triggers, returning The Peregrine Dynamo from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

7-539-2232-3396-3703.notablePrerequisites: At least one +1/+1 counter among creatures you control.
7-539-2232-3396-3703.description:
Cast Quirion Sentinel for {G}, triggering Sporemound and Cloudstone Curio.
Quirion Sentinel triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's trigger choosing not to return another permanent.
Resolve Sporemound's trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling token triggers Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's trigger returning Quirion Sentinel to your hand.
Repeat.

2556-3557-4872.notablePrerequisites:
Brago does not have summoning sickness.
Brago can not be blocked.
2556-3557-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
Move to your combat phase.
Deal combat damage with Brago, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
